verdict.rationale: Plausible documents first-party funnel analysis: you define a sequence of steps, see how many visitors complete each one, and find where they drop off. It offers both sequential and strict-order funnel types. Dashboard-wide filters by sources, countries, pages and segments are documented, but nothing explicitly confirms they apply inside funnel reports. missing for 10: explicit evidence that filters apply to funnels, any evidence of breakdowns (segmenting funnel steps by dimension), independent or hands-on corroboration of the funnel feature.
